title: First person mobile rpg prototype - Feedback
author: anomalyhunterx
selftext:
Hey all, here's an update, I deleted my first post about this, but now I think I have a solid prototype with basic first level, weapon, enemy, combat, loot system, character system in place!

I made engine/code  with Claude, used midjourney for environmental textures, skeleton ememy base art with chatgpt, animated with ludo, and ui stuff from opengameart

Feedback appreciated, I am at a bit of a crossroads, it seems daunting to fully develop this into a real game beyond a basic demo. I am also terrified of the backlash I will receive if I start posting this in other places and people see I've used AI art. I would prefer to use human made art but I don't have the budget. 

I am thinking I should keep making more enemies and levels and weapons with AI as a logical next step, or maybe I should look for some real artists? Idk

Do you guys think this has potential?
